request.input:
1girl, solo, adult woman standing among a field of tall silver reed plumes at sunset, calm quiet expression, looking gently toward the viewer, her long thick braid and warm scarf carried sideways by the wind, right hand lightly gathering her scarf at her upper chest, left hand lowered beside her hip brushing a few reed plumes

Wide game homepage wallpaper, a quiet winter sunset walk through silver reeds, completely redesigned warm contemporary outdoor outfit.

Landscape composition, woman on the left-center at about forty percent of image width, head and both hands visible above the reeds, body below the upper thighs mostly occluded naturally by grasses. Layered reed plumes in the foreground sweep toward the right, spectacular deep blue cloud formations and honey-gold sunset on the right. A few thin wooden path-marker stakes with narrow red ribbons recede through the reeds. Her braid and scarf flow toward the right with the same wind as the reeds and ribbons. Keep distant scenery and outer edges economical for a game-menu overlay, artwork only.

Cold silver-blue winter light in reed shadows, warm amber rim light along her face, braid and wool coat, richly colored but controlled dusk sky. Matte deep petrol teal wool overcoat, oatmeal knitted high collar, warm ochre scarf, charcoal skirt, fine clean warm skin, quiet fabric planes and coherent long hair locks, high complexity

arknights, game promotional illustration, painterly anime illustration. Complete, clean silhouettes and carefully resolved facial features and hands. Use clear grouped shadows and angular cloth folds. Keep fine linework selective around the eyes, fingers and accessories. Skin has delicate restrained transitions.
